output_encoding.description: Decode stage that produced the tool output (GAP-ENCODING-GATE, OPS-PROTOCOL §8): utf-8 / utf-8-sig / gb18030 / utf-8-lossy, comma-joined for multi-chunk streams. FUS-HOST-RESOURCE-SAFETY §4.4 (2026-09-12, 0z S1) adds the wide-text stages produced by read_file's decode-first gate for text-family files: utf-16le / utf-16be.

delivery_phase.description: AGENT-DELIVERY-FLOW (2026-08-23, 设计 §2.2): the `submit` two-phase marker — requested = the mechanical delivery status was rendered into the blackboard plan view (pending confirmation); confirmed = the terminal step was marked done and the run entered the final-answer flow.

wall_ms.description: THIN-HARNESS-REDESIGN-V2 §9.6 (2026-08-29 S5-1): the tool call's wall-clock duration from ToolStarted to ToolCompleted, in milliseconds. Present on executed tool completions (generic host path and run_tests); refusals (no ToolStarted) carry no wall_ms. For a mid-run completion (`running: true`, §9.7 S5-2) wall_ms is the elapsed time at the 300s report point where the command auto-backgrounded — the call is not yet finished.

timed_out.description: THIN-HARNESS-REDESIGN-V2 §9.6 (2026-08-29 S5-1): present only when the tool call ended by timeout — the host's per-call wall-clock kill or a tool-side client timeout (e.g. web_search's 120s budget, surfaced via ToolError::Timeout).

running.description: THIN-HARNESS-REDESIGN-V2 §9.7 (2026-08-29 S5-2): present when the tool call completed with the command still running — run_terminal_cmd auto-backgrounded at the 300s report point (exit_code null, tool_running journaled just before this completion).

output_truncated.description: TER W-F13b (2026-09-03, TODO2 T0.2): 工具结果内联输出被截断才出现的显式截断标记；完整输出可经持久化检索对象(output_object_id) 或落盘文件补读。

total_bytes.description: TER W-F13b (2026-09-03, TODO2 T0.2): 工具结果总输出字节（截断前单调计数），与 output_truncated 成对出现（verifier 强制）。

output_object_id.description: TER W-F13b (2026-09-03, TODO2 T0.2): 长输出落盘检索对象指针（pattern / 行区间 / 尾部 N 行语义），模型补读自身输出不再依赖 .gsa。

file_path.description: FUS-READ-ANCHOR-WRITE-GUARD (2026-08-21): the target file path carried by search_replace refusal completions (content_anchor_mismatch). Kept as the producer's existing top-level field; the failure-target identity (F4, 2026-08-30) duplicates it inside failure_target.path for anchor_target.

candidate_count.description: FUS-RETRIEVAL-MECH P0-B step 2/4 (2026-08-14): the per-activation deduplicated candidate count after this call (or at refusal), shared by the web_fetch family and browser_read (local_browser second segment). Present only on candidate-counted tool_completed events; pairing/range/error-shape rules are enforced by the Python cross-layer verifier (_verify_v02_candidate_count), keeping the schema shape minimal.

candidate_cap.description: FUS-RETRIEVAL-MECH P0-B step 2/4 (2026-08-14): the candidate cap in effect (ORZ_WEB_FETCH_CANDIDATE_CAP, default 8), shared by web_fetch and browser_read. Present together with candidate_count.

serp_budget_used.description: P0-0v P2-4 (2026-09-10): the lane's consumed SERP engine-navigation count at the dispatch-time refusal (browser_control_search_budget_exceeded). Unit is engine navigations, not search calls — one auto search may navigate up to three engines. Present together with serp_budget_cap.

serp_budget_cap.description: P0-0v P2-4 (2026-09-10): the lane SERP engine-navigation budget in effect (main/grill = 8 per run; external retrieval = 8/16/32 by effort tier). Present together with serp_budget_used.

serp_session_navigations.description: P0-0v P2-3 (2026-09-10): the browser session's consumed SERP engine-navigation count (shared across lanes, one browser per session) at a refusal that protects the retrieval-lane session floor (browser_control_search_session_reserved). Present together with serp_session_ceiling.

serp_session_ceiling.description: P0-0v P2-3 (2026-09-10): the browser session's SERP engine-navigation ceiling (SERP_MAX_NAVIGATIONS_PER_SESSION) in effect at that refusal. Present together with serp_session_navigations.

inject_tokens_used.description: ORZ-CACHE-CONTEXT-COST (2026-08-15, ADR-0010 §3.6): the accumulated estimated tokens of this model round's injected tool results at the refusal (round_inject_budget_exceeded). Present together with inject_tokens_budget.

inject_tokens_budget.description: ORZ-CACHE-CONTEXT-COST (2026-08-15, ADR-0010 §3.6): the per-round injection budget in effect (ORZ_MAX_INJECT_TOKENS_PER_ROUND, default 50K). Present together with inject_tokens_used.

source.description: P0-C S3 前置 (2026-08-15, P1-2 定案): the refusing gate family — permission bridge / ACAF ticket gate / retrieval mode gate / taint (reserved). 0p S2 (2026-09-07, ADR-0010 §14.61 design C): source=permission now also carries built-in tool-sandbox read denials (codes outside_workspace / session_volume_notice / session_volume_agent_invisible) — the W2 D-3 audit gap (deny without envelope) is closed; permission-denial completions are journaled with status=error + non-zero exit_code.

policy_denial.description: P0-C S3 前置 (2026-08-15, P1-2 定案): structured policy denial carried by a refusal completion — controller-side no-ToolStarted refusals (ACAF ticket gate / retrieval mode gates) or a host-level structured denial on a ToolStarted+ToolCompleted. 0p S2 (2026-09-07): source=permission extends to built-in tool-sandbox read denials (read_file/grep/list_dir) — codes: outside_workspace (workspace escape), session_volume_notice (two-stage gate first-read notice envelope; a following read journals session_volume_opened), session_volume_agent_invisible (escape shapes and the permanently-denied credentials region). Every policy_denial completion must be self-describing: status=error, non-zero exit_code and the tool must belong to the known refusal path for the source — enforced by the journal verifier families, keeping the schema shape minimal.

session_volume_opened.description: 0p S2 two-stage gate (2026-09-07, ADR-0010 §14.61 design B4; 0p S2 复审核准 2026-09-07): present on each read_file/grep/list_dir completion that served content from the `.gsa` session-volume internal region AFTER the notice — design B4 marks every post-notice internal access (open_after_notice audit trail), not only the first one. Pairs with the preceding `policy_denial{code=session_volume_notice}` completion. Window paths (session/terminal/*.log, run_tests_output.txt, resources_state.json) and the mechanism file access_state.json never set this field.

failure_agg_absent.description: 0q 统一失败事件管线 (2026-09-08, ADR-0010 §14.63): 「漏斗已评估、有意不聚合」标记 —— identity-capable 工具（四族并集）的 error 形状完成未过聚合时的 journal 可见事实（None-identity / 非四写点拒绝形状 / 0p S2 信封优先口径除外——后者自带 policy_denial，无本字段）。与 failure_target 互斥（XOR，failure_agg_coverage 法官族执法）；仅 funnel-v1 之后的刊出现（run_started.failure_pipeline = "funnel-v1"）。

kind.description: MECHANICAL-LAYER-MATH-CALCULUS F4 §5.2 (2026-08-30): the failure-target identity family — terminal command / GetPut anchor / file path / canonical URL.

id.description: Deterministic SHA-256 digest of the canonical target (command text / anchor triple / path / canonical URL), §5.2. The journal never carries full command text — only the digest plus the bounded preview.

cmd_preview.description: F4 §5.2: bounded (≤ 80 B) preview of the canonical command, present iff kind=cmd_target. JSON Schema maxLength counts characters; the 80-byte contract is enforced by the Python verifier (UTF-8 byte length, 审查处理 R8 / F8).

path.description: F4 §5.2: file path identity, present iff kind=file_target or anchor_target.

anchor_hash.description: F4 §5.2: GetPut anchor content hash (sha256), present iff kind=anchor_target.

size.description: F4 §5.2: anchor file size, present iff kind=anchor_target.

canonical_url.description: F4 §5.2: canonical URL identity, present iff kind=url_target.

failure_target.description: F4 §5.3: optional failure-target identity on failure completions (tool_completed status=error of the command/anchor/file/URL tool families). Kind/format/field-presence rules are cross-checked by the Python verifier (_verify_v02_failure_target).

console_mode.description: PLAN-FIRST 阶段 C (2026-08-16, ADR-0010 §14.17⑱): present exactly when the completion belongs to a direct-mode model action (audited fallback) — the event chain correlates to the console_mode_transition via transition_id.

transition_id.description: PLAN-FIRST 阶段 C (2026-08-16, ADR-0010 §14.17⑱): the console → direct transition this completion belongs to (present together with console_mode).

trace_id.description: PLAN-FIRST 阶段 C (2026-08-16, ADR-0010 §14.17⑱): the console trace id of the direct action (call_id) — console_step_done evidence requires a trace_id corresponding to an already-occurred ToolCompleted.

epoch.description: FUS-BLACKBOARD-PLAN-EPOCH / P2-10 R4 (2026-08-31 S4 实机复验对齐): the plan-epoch archive the blackboard_read completion read from (cross-epoch look-back). Present on blackboard_read completions when the caller passed the epoch argument; the tool definition declares the same parameter.

kind.description: P2-11 第 4 项 / 依赖图主线设计 §5 (2026-09-01): read = read_file success (read→write anchor-chain source); write = search_replace success (tool→entity mutation edge). Present only on successful read_file/search_replace completions; D3 command/retrieval side effects never carry dep_graph.

path.description: Normalized target file path (same normalization as the entity registry).

anchor.description: read fact: content anchor at read time (sha256 authoritative ≤16MB; null when oversized/non-file).

consumed_read.description: write fact: the read fact call_id this write's expected_anchor was consumed from (read→write anchor edge); null when no matching in-run read fact.

consumed_anchor.description: write fact: the expected_anchor carried by the write arguments (may carry only size/mtime).

new_anchor.description: write fact: content anchor after the write (same computation as read anchors).

dep_graph.description: P2-11 第 4 项 (2026-09-01): dependency-graph fact journaled with successful read_file/search_replace completions — the file-anchor chain (read→write anchor edges + tool→entity mutation edges; D3 command/retrieval side effects are never graphed). Shape/cross-reference rules are enforced by the Python verifier (_verify_v02_dep_graph_events), keeping the schema shape minimal.
